runtimeObservation.testOrderSource: scripts/build.js:226-239 appends imports directly from await globby(sources), without sorting. Specs/karma.conf.cjs:18 sets Jasmine random:false.
runtimeObservation.testOrderInference: Filesystem/glob enumeration can change suite registration order; the recorded selected-spec order actually differs. This observation does not prove the cause of the ShadowMap differences.
